mentions.name: composable-indexes
mentions.description: A Rust library for indexing a collection on multiple dimensions in a type-safe and composable manner, providing a safer and more concise alternative to maintaining multiple HashMaps while being less involved and simpler than an in-memory SQLite.
mentions.problem: Maintaining multiple HashMaps is unsafe and verbose, while in-memory SQLite is too involved for simple multi-dimensional indexing of collections.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to make my Rust library `composable-indexes` more ergonomic. It is for indexing a collection on multiple dimensions in a type-safe and composable manner.
